from base_sensor import BaseVirtualSensor

class TMP102_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x0000,  # TEMP
            0x01: 0x60A0,  # CONFIG
            0x02: 0x4B00,  # TLOW
            0x03: 0x5000,  # THIGH
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError("Invalid register address")
        
        value = self.regs[addr]
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (value >> 8) & 0xFF
        return value

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr not in self.regs:
            raise ValueError("Invalid register address")
        
        if nbytes == 1:
            # Update only bits 15:8
            mask = 0xFF00
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & ~mask) | ((data << 8) & mask)
        else:
            # Handle read-only registers
            if addr == 0x00:  # TEMP
                return
            if addr == 0x01:  # CONFIG
                # Ensure R1 and R0 are read-only
                mask = 0xC000
                self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & mask) | (data & ~mask)
            if addr == 0x02:  # TLOW
                # Ensure UNUSED bits are read-only
                mask = 0x000F
                self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & mask) | (data & ~mask)
            if addr == 0x03:  # THIGH
